scenes.headline: How agent traces become a smaller model you own
scenes.sub: Overmind's open loop, from code scan to fine-tune.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ledger! Here is how Overmind turns the work your agent already does into a smaller model you own.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Your agent's production traces are training data: the expensive model's own answers become the labels for a small open model.
scenes.mark: the expensive model's own answers become the labels
scenes.say: Your agent's traces are training data. The expensive model's own answers become the labels for a small open model.

scenes.title: From repo and traces to weights

steps.say: Your own coding agent reads the repo and writes a card for each capability: one product purpose, its tools, its expected steps.
Production traces bind to a capability, and an agent in the Data Workshop cleans them into rows, one row per trace.
The last answer in each trace becomes the label. The model you want to replace writes the gold answers.
Unsloth and a standard trainer fine-tune an open model, usually with LoRA, and the weights are yours to download.

steps.label: split by trace
steps.say: The split keeps a trace or a conversation together. But five questions about one contract are five traces, so that contract lands on both sides.

steps.label: group by contract
steps.say: Name the contract as a group, and each one goes wholly to train or to eval. The default does not do that.

parts.note: a quote that is not in the contract
parts.say: On top, the quotes a model made up.
Underneath, every question, even the ones where the right answer is that the clause is not there.

scenes.title: Invented quotes per question
scenes.say: On Overmind's contract test, the untrained base model invented quotes exactly as often as the flagship. Fine-tuning took it to zero point one two percent.

scenes.text: The loop is sound. The 28x came from a contract benchmark, not from traces, and its code is not in the repo.
scenes.say: The loop is sound. The twenty-eight times came from a contract benchmark, not from anyone's traces, and its code is not in the repo.

recap: Traces become labels written by your incumbent
Group splits by document, not just trace
The 28x is the fine-tune, not the size
scenes.say: Traces become labels. Group your splits by document. And the gain came from fine-tuning, not from being small.
